objectives.title: Domain Admin
objectives.prompt: Find an attack path in badblood.local, reach Domain Admin and read C:\ctf\flag.txt on dc01.
hints: The domain is huge and random: collect it with a graph tool and ask for shortest paths to Domain Admins.
Accounts with an SPN or with pre-authentication disabled are common starting points.
Read the edges: GenericAll, WriteDacl, ForceChangePassword and group memberships are all steps on a path.

steps.title: Name the domain
steps.prompt: What is the DNS name of the Active Directory domain?

steps.title: Map the domain
steps.prompt: Which open-source tool turns collected AD data into a graph of attack paths?

steps.title: Roast a service
steps.prompt: Which attack requests Kerberos service tickets for accounts that have an SPN, then cracks them offline?

steps.title: Read an edge
steps.prompt: Which AD permission gives full control over an object, so it can reset a user's password or change a group's members? (BloodHound edge name)
